from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) as stated in the text")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 民事判决书, 行政裁定书)")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt anchoring the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
